description: Product Name: Power BI Baidu ECharts Advanced Radar Visualization Object Version: 1.0.0 Release date: December 3, 2024 Developer: [Infortime Shiqin] Main functions: 1. Data driven visualization: Users can directly drive radar charts through the data model of Power BI to achieve dynamic data display. 2. Highly customizable: Provides multiple customization options, including color, font, legend position, etc., to meet the display needs of different users. 3. Interactivity: Supports interactive operations such as mouse hovering and clicking, enhancing user experience. 4. Responsive design: Radar images can adapt to different display devices and resolutions. 5. Multi language support: Supports multiple languages to meet the needs of global users. Usage scenario: -Performance evaluation: Show the performance of different employees or teams on multiple key performance indicators. -Product comparison: Compare the performance of different products in multiple characteristics, such as price, performance, reliability, etc. -Market research: Display consumers' preferences in multiple attributes, such as brand, quality, price, etc. -Skill analysis: showcasing the distribution of individual or team abilities across multiple skill domains.
